grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lentils, spinach, eggs, flour, feta, yoghurt and radishes are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a sieve and a frying pan, and the techniques suit a beginner.

works.reason: Simmered red lentils bound with egg, flour and feta make a workable fritter batter, and the quantities give about three fritters each for four at lunch.

honest_times.reason: The 15 cook minutes cannot cover the 10-minute lentil simmer plus frying the fritters in batches at 3 minutes a side, which is at least two rounds of 6 minutes, so the real time runs well past the printed 35 for a quick lunch.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the lemon for both zest and juice, and the steps use nothing unlisted apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: 200g of April spinach is the heart of the fritters, with spring onions and radishes to match, which suits a late April lunch.

plain_voice.reason: The steps read as plain, clear British home-cook instructions.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, spinach, eggs and feta with yoghurt and radishes make a filling, balanced lunch a family would eat again.
